title: Short-term Work Permits for Foreign Domestic Workers to Provide Respite Support for Singaporean Families
what_it_is: Short-term Work Permits for Foreign Domestic Workers to Provide Respite Support for Singaporean Families

sections.label: Short-term Work Permits for FDWs
sections.summary: The Minister was asked whether short-term Work Permits for foreign domestic workers would be considered for respite support and employment agencies.

sentences.text: To ask the Minister for Manpower whether the Ministry will consider introducing short-term Work Permits for foreign domestic workers (FDWs) to provide respite support for families and to allow employment agencies to cater to families requiring short-term domestic help.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: It could be detrimental to an FDW to be brought into Singapore for short-term respite support, where she may encounter uncertainty about the duration of work or when the employers' needs change suddenly.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: To help families with short-term options, the Ministry of Manpower (MOM) introduced the Household Services Scheme (HSS) in 2017, which allows foreign workers to provide domestic services, such as cleaning, to households.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: While they may be deployed to specific households for short periods of time, the foreign workers under HSS are employed full-time by the service providers and on longer duration contracts.

sections.label: FDW Work Permit duration
sections.summary: The FDW's Work Permit is set at two years to provide certainty and stability to the FDW and the employer.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: On the first question on the time duration of the Work Permit, the FDW's Work Permit is set at two years to provide certainty and stability to both the FDW and also the employer.

sections.label: Household Services Scheme review
sections.summary: The Household Services Scheme was piloted in September 2017, and MOM is prepared to consider including caregiving and short-term respite care companies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: On the second question about HSS, it was piloted in September 2017 to provide domestic cleaning services for employers who require such support services.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: And we are always reviewing to see how we can improve it.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: So, I want to assure Mr Melvin Yong and also Mr Desmond Choo who filed the Parliamentary Question that MOM is prepared to consider including companies which provide caregiving services and short-term respite care with MOH's support and if there is industry demand.

sections.label: FDW concession purpose
sections.summary: The FDW concession is meant to support families with young kids and families with the elderly.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Currently, the FDW concession is meant to support families with young kids and also families with the elderly.
